# ping_test (Resource)

Resource for managing Ping Tests in Catchpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    catchpoint = {
      source  = "catchpoint/catchpoint"
      version = "2.0.0"
    }
  }
}

resource "ping_test" "minimal_pingtest" {
  provider      = catchpoint
  division_id   = 2633
  product_id    = 23791
  test_location = "www.example.com"
  test_name     = "minimal ping test"
  monitor       = "ping tcp"

  schedule_settings { schedule_setting_type = "inherit" }
  advanced_settings { advanced_setting_type = "inherit" }
  alert_settings { alert_setting_type = "inherit" }
}

resource "ping_test" "ping_test" {
  test_name     = "Ping_TF3"
  provider      = catchpoint
  division_id   = 2633
  product_id    = 23791
  test_location = "www.example.com"
  monitor       = "ping tcp"
  status        = "active"
  start_time    = "2024-04-30T04:59:00Z"
  end_time      = "2024-10-30T04:59:00Z"

  advanced_settings {
    additional_monitor            = "traceroute icmp"
    enable_path_mtu_discovery     = true
    verify_test_on_failure        = true
    debug_primary_host_on_failure = true
  }

  thresholds {
    test_time_critical    = 250
    test_time_warning     = 50
    availability_critical = 80
    availability_warning  = 90
  }

  alert_settings {
    alert_setting_type = "inherit"
  }

  schedule_settings {
    frequency          = "6 hours"
    node_distribution  = "random"
    no_of_subset_nodes = 5
    node_ids           = [6388]
    node_group_ids     = [9922, 9848]
  }
}

resource "ping_test" "imported_pingtest" {
  provider      = catchpoint
  division_id   = 2633
  product_id    = 23791
  test_location = "www.example.com"
  test_name     = "imported ping test"
  monitor       = "ping tcp"

  schedule_settings { schedule_setting_type = "inherit" }
  advanced_settings { advanced_setting_type = "inherit" }
  alert_settings { alert_setting_type = "inherit" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `division_id` (Number) The Division where the Test will be created
- `monitor` (String) Set the monitor type, value must be one of: ["ping icmp" "ping udp" "ping tcp"]
- `product_id` (Number) The parent Product under which the Test will be created
- `test_location` (String) The domain or IP to be tested. Example: catchpoint.com
- `test_name` (String) The name of the Test

### Optional

- `advanced_settings` (Block, Optional) Used for overriding the advanced settings section. 
			Note: omitting this field entirely means that the advanced settings for this object will not be tracked.
			If you specifically want the object to inherit the parent advanced settings then supply an object with only the advanced_setting_type
			field, e.g. '{ advanced_setting_type = "Inherit" }'. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--advanced_settings))
- `alert_settings` (Block, Optional) Used for overriding the alert settings section. 
			Note: omitting this field entirely means that the alert settings for this object will not be tracked.
			If you specifically want the object to inherit the parent alert settings then supply an object with only the alert_setting_type 
			field, e.g. '{ alert_setting_type = "Inherit" }'. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--alert_settings))
- `alerts_paused` (Boolean) Switch for pausing Test alerts. Default: false
- `enable_test_data_webhook` (Boolean) Switch for enabling test data webhook feature. Default: true
- `end_time` (String) End time for the Test in ISO format like 2027-12-30T04:59:00Z
- `folder_id` (Number) The Folder under which the Test will be created
- `label` (Block List) Labels with key,[values] pairs (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--label))
- `schedule_settings` (Block, Optional) Used for overriding the schedule settings section. 
			Note: omitting this field entirely means that the schedule settings for this object will not be tracked.
			If you specifically want the object to inherit the parent schedule settings then supply an object with only the schedule_setting_type
			field, e.g. '{ schedule_setting_type = "Inherit" }'. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--schedule_settings))
- `start_time` (String) Start time for the Test in ISO format like 2027-12-30T04:59:00Z
- `status` (String) Set the Test status, value must be one of: ["active" "inactive"]
- `test_description` (String) The Test description
- `thresholds` (Block, Optional) Test thresholds for test time and availability percentage (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--thresholds))

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier for the Test. This is only set by the API and should be 0 for a new test.

<a id="nestedblock--advanced_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `advanced_settings`

Optional:

- `additional_monitor` (String) Set the additional monitor to run along with the test monitor, value must be one of: ["ping icmp" "ping tcp" "ping udp" "traceroute icmp" "traceroute tcp" "traceroute udp"]
- `advanced_setting_type` (String) Set the advanced settings type, value must be one of: ["inherit" "override"]
- `debug_primary_host_on_failure` (Boolean) True enables debug primary host on failure setting
- `enable_path_mtu_discovery` (Boolean) True enables Path MTU Discovery
- `verify_test_on_failure` (Boolean) True enables verify on test failure setting


<a id="nestedblock--alert_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alert_settings`

Optional:

- `alert_rule` (Block List) Sets the alert rule with attributes such as threshold, trigger type, warning, critical trigger and more (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--alert_settings--alert_rule))
- `alert_setting_type` (String) Set the alert setting type, value must be one of: ["inherit" "inherit & add" "override"]
- `notification_group` (Block, Optional) Notification group for setting up alert recipients, adding alert webhook ids. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--alert_settings--notification_group))

<a id="nestedblock--alert_settings--alert_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alert_settings.alert_rule`

Required:

- `alert_type` (String) Sets the alert type, [asn availability byte length content match dns experience score host failure insight path ping requests test failure timing]
- `node_threshold_type` (String) Sets the alert node threshold type, value must be one of: ["average across nodes" "node" "runs"]

Optional:

- `alert_sub_type` (String) Sets the alert sub type, [# asns # cities # connections # countries # css # flash # hops # hosts # html # images # media # other # redirects # requests # scripts # xml % downtime any urls byte length child urls compare to file compare to previous connect content content load days to expiration dns dns additional dns answer dns authority dns general document complete dom load file size handshake time indicators load origin as origin neighbor page path as ping packet loss ping rtt prefix mismatch reachability redirect regular expression response response code response headers send server response test test time test time with suspect test urls tracepoints ttfb wait]
- `all_match_records` (Boolean) Set to true to match all DNS records when evaluating DNS alerts
- `consecutive_number_of_runs` (Number) Sets the number of consecutive runs only if enable_consecutive field is true and node_threshold_type is node
- `critical_reminder` (String) Sets the alert critical reminder interval, value must be one of: ["1 hour" "1 minute" "10 minutes" "15 minutes" "30 minutes" "5 minutes" "daily" "none"]
- `critical_trigger` (Number) Critical trigger value for 'specific value' and 'trailing value' trigger types.
- `dns_record_type` (String) Sets the DNS record type for DNS alert types, value must be one of: ["AorAAAA" "a" "aaaa" "cname" "ns"]
- `dns_resolved_name` (String) Sets the DNS resolved name for DNS alert types
- `dns_ttl` (Number) Sets the DNS TTL (time to live) for DNS alert types
- `enable_consecutive` (Boolean) Checks consecutive number of runs or nodes for triggering alerts.
- `enforce_test_failure` (Boolean) Sets enforce test failure property for an alert
- `expression` (String) Sets trigger expression for content match alert type
- `historical_interval` (String) Sets the alert historical interval, value must be one of: ["1 day" "1 hour" "1 week" "10 minutes" "12 hours" "15 minutes" "2 hours" "30 minutes" "5 minutes" "6 hours"]
- `level` (Block, Optional) Filter configuration for the alert level (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--alert_settings--alert_rule--level))
- `notification_group` (Block List) List of Notification groups for configuring alert notifications, including recipients' email addresses and alert settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--alert_settings--alert_rule--notification_group))
- `notification_type` (String) Sets the alert notification type, value must be one of: ["default contacts"]
- `number_of_failing_nodes` (Number) Sets the number of failed nodes the alert should trigger if node_threshold_type is 'average across nodes'
- `omit_scatterplot` (Boolean) Omits scatterplot image from alert emails if set to true
- `operation_type` (String) Sets the alert operation type, value must be one of: ["equals" "greater than" "greater than or equals" "less than" "less than or equals" "not equals"]
- `statistical_type` (String) Sets the alert statistical type, value must be one of: ["average"]
- `threshold_interval` (String) Sets the alert threshold interval, value must be one of: ["1 hour" "10 minutes" "12 hours" "15 minutes" "2 hours" "30 minutes" "5 minutes" "6 hours" "default"]
- `threshold_number_of_runs` (Number) Sets the threshold for the number of runs or nodes the alert should trigger
- `threshold_percentage_of_runs` (Number) Sets the threshold for the percentage of runs the alert should trigger
- `trigger_type` (String) Sets the alert trigger type, value must be one of: ["specific value" "trailing value" "trendshift"]
- `use_rolling_window` (Boolean) Set to true for using rolling window instead of schedule time threshold
- `warning_reminder` (String) Sets the alert warning reminder interval, value must be one of: ["1 hour" "1 minute" "10 minutes" "15 minutes" "30 minutes" "5 minutes" "daily" "none"]
- `warning_trigger` (Number) Warning trigger value for 'specific value' and 'trailing value' trigger types.

<a id="nestedblock--alert_settings--alert_rule--level"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alert_settings.alert_rule.level`

Optional:

- `filter_type` (String) The type of filter to apply, value must be one of: ["address" "index" "name"]
- `filter_value` (String) The value for the filter


<a id="nestedblock--alert_settings--alert_rule--notification_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alert_settings.alert_rule.notification_group`

Optional:

- `contact_group_ids` (List of Number) List of contact groups to receive alert notifications.
- `notify_on_critical` (Boolean) Set to true to include critical alerts in notifications.
- `notify_on_improved` (Boolean) Set to true to include improved alerts in notifications.
- `notify_on_warning` (Boolean) Set to true to include warning alerts in notifications.
- `recipient_emails` (List of String) List of email addresses to receive alert notifications.
- `subject` (String) Email subject for the alert notifications.

Read-Only:

- `alert_webhook_ids` (List of Number) Alert webhook ids for the webhook endpoints to associate with this alert setting.



<a id="nestedblock--alert_settings--notification_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alert_settings.notification_group`

Optional:

- `alert_webhook_ids` (List of Number) Alert webhook ids for the webhook endpoints to associate with this alert setting.
- `contact_group_ids` (List of Number) A set of contact groups to receive alert notifications.
- `recipient_emails` (List of String) List of emails to alert.
- `subject` (String) Email subject for the alert notifications.

Read-Only:

- `notify_on_critical` (Boolean)
- `notify_on_improved` (Boolean)
- `notify_on_warning` (Boolean)

### Nested Schema for `label`

Required:

- `values` (List of String) Label values


<a id="nestedblock--schedule_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule_settings`

Optional:

- `frequency` (String) The frequency in seconds for the Test to run, value must be one of: ["1 minute" "10 minutes" "12 hours" "15 minutes" "2 hours" "2 minutes" "20 minutes" "24 hours" "3 hours" "30 minutes" "4 hours" "4 minutes" "5 minutes" "6 hours" "60 minutes" "8 hours" "none"]
- `maintenance_schedule_id` (Number) The Maintenance Schedule ID to use for the Test
- `no_of_subset_nodes` (Number) The number of subset nodes to use for the Test
- `node_distribution` (String) The node distribution for the Test, value must be one of: ["concurrent" "random"]
- `node_group_ids` (List of Number) The list of Node Group IDs to use for the Test
- `node_ids` (List of Number) The list of Node IDs to use for the Test
- `run_schedule_id` (Number) The Run Schedule ID to use for the Test
- `schedule_setting_type` (String) Set the schedule setting type, value must be one of: ["inherit" "override"]

### Nested Schema for `thresholds`

Optional:

- `availability_critical` (Number) The availability critical threshold

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import ping_test.imported_pingtest 123456
```
